copy.mass.title: Stars under pressure
copy.mass.helpCollapse: After nine showers the star implodes, swallowing itself and its four directly touching neighbors for no starlight. Collect it before then, or let the collapse make space. Pausing stops aging.
copy.mass.helpValue: Purple stars still match their original family. Paired glints mark matching growth worth two starlight; age adds no points. Dusk stays in retained rounds only.
copy.mass.help: Every star, including Opal, ages with the showers—even underneath other stars. Stage two arrives after three showers; stage three turns purple after six.
copy.mass.warning: A purple star implodes in {showers}. Collect it or move its neighbors to safety.
copy.mass.targets: Swallows itself and these currently touching stars for no starlight: {positions}.

copy.lesson.title: Try a setup
copy.lesson.intro: Explore a few moves at your own pace. Your sky stays paused while you try these examples.
copy.lesson.squareStart: Move the upper-right Spark left to trade places with Pip. This makes four matching stars in a square.
copy.lesson.squareReady: The swap made a square, without clearing anything. Hold a Spark, trace the four corners, then lift to clear just those stars.
copy.lesson.squareDone: Four Sparks cleared for 4 starlight. Both Pips remain. In your sky, a quick swipe swaps; holding first lets you draw.
copy.lesson.crossStart: Start at the middle Spark. Hold, trace each arm, and retrace through the middle to reach the next. Each star counts once.
copy.lesson.crossDone: Five Sparks cleared for 5 starlight. The four Pips were outside the traced cross, so they remain and fall into place.
copy.lesson.opalStart: Opal can bridge the two Sparks. Start on a blue, four-point Spark to choose that family, then tap to clear the group.
copy.lesson.opalDone: The two Sparks and Opal cleared for 3 starlight. Green, six-point Pip stays: Opal cannot join different colors in one clear.
copy.lesson.relayStart: The yellow Sunnys support two blue Sparks. Tap the Sunnys to make room below them.
copy.lesson.relayReady: Those Sparks fell into a new square. It waits for your next move. Hold and trace that square to continue the relay.
copy.lesson.relayDone: The new square cleared for 4 more starlight. That is a relay: your first clear created the next shape. There is no automatic clear or score multiplier.
copy.lesson.exampleNote: Outlined stars show the next move. Use the button to see it, then try the described gesture in your sky.
copy.lesson.failed: This example is no longer ready for that move. Try again to reset it.
copy.help.tap: Tap matching stars connected up, down, left or right. Small stars count as 1 and grown stars as 2. You need a total of 3 to clear the group.
copy.help.identity: A grown star and a matching small star are enough. Match by color, shape and character. Small stars normally earn 1 starlight; grown stars earn 2. Gray stars earn none.
copy.help.trace: Hold a star until it glows, then draw through 5 or more matching stars and lift your finger. Only the stars you trace will clear. Each star can touch the previous star or cross one empty space in a straight line, including diagonally. Another star blocks the gap.
copy.help.branch: You can retrace your path to branch out. Each star counts once, even when grown. Leave the board to cancel. In Open sky, a four-star square can also clear as a recipe.
copy.help.accessibleTrace: With VoiceOver, use Add to constellation on each star, then Release constellation. Use Cancel constellation to start over.
copy.help.opening: New skies begin with a few quick showers. You can clear stars as they settle. Your chosen shower pace follows the opening.
copy.help.forecast: The trail shows the stars in the next shower. The round ends when an arriving star has nowhere to land. Clearing stars does not reset the shower countdown.
copy.help.growth: When a matching star lands on a small star, that star grows. A grown star cannot grow again; the next star stacks above it.
copy.help.opal: The round white Opal Orb can join one matching color. Start a tap match or trace on a colored star to include it. The orb counts as 1, never grows, and disappears when cleared. It cannot connect different colors in one clear.
copy.help.storm: New skies alternate 9 lighter showers with 3 heavy storm showers. Heavy showers bring more stars. Faster showers leave less time between arrivals. The forecast describes the next shower, including when its pace changes.
copy.help.retained: Older saved skies and their replays keep their original shower rules. Choose New sky to use the current rules.
copy.help.dusk: Dusk turns stars directly above, below, left or right gray. Gray stars still match and grow, but earn no starlight. Each shower with a touching star feeds Dusk once. After {feeds} feeding showers, Dusk swallows those stars and disappears. This frees space without earning starlight.
copy.help.duskClear: Clear a matching group directly beside Dusk to remove it early. Surviving gray stars regain their light. Stars in the clearing group earn their reward before Dusk is removed, so any still-gray stars in that group earn zero.
copy.help.darkLegacy: In this saved sky, dark stars block nearby growth. Clear a matching group directly beside one to remove it. They do not feed or turn other stars gray.
copy.help.pause: Pause sky stops automatic showers. You can keep clearing or tap Next shower for one shower. Opening the menu or leaving the app suspends play. Missed showers do not build up.
copy.help.swap: In Open sky, swipe a star left, right, up or down to swap with its neighbor immediately. Each swipe moves one space, whatever the colors. Moving into an empty space lets stars fall. Hold still first when you want to draw a constellation.
copy.help.recipe: In Open sky, a square uses exactly 4 matching stars; a cross uses 5. An Opal Orb can join their color. Trace the shape to clear only those stars.
copy.help.relay: Clearing supporting stars can drop others into a new shape. Clear that new shape to build a relay. Shapes wait until you clear them: there is no automatic chain reaction or score multiplier.
copy.help.challenge: Restore Lantern Landing with 18 starlight. Each clear brings its light back. Finish before an arriving star has nowhere to land. Use tap matches or five-star traces. Showers arrive at a steady pace. This challenge has no swaps, shape recipes, Dusk, Opal Orbs or storms.
